'''Neil K. Garg''' is a Distinguished [[professor]] of [[chemistry]] and holds the [[Kenneth N. Trueblood]] Endowed Chair at the [[University of California, Los Angeles]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.chemistry.ucla.edu/directory/garg-neil-k|title=Neil K. Garg|publisher=ucla.edu|access-date=January 23, 2017}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=About Neil |url=https://garg.chem.ucla.edu/about-neil |access-date=2024-07-28 |website=Garg Lab |language=en-US}}</ref>

Garg's research is in synthetic and physical organic chemistry. His group challenges long-standing paradigms of reactivity and develops practical synthetic methods.

The Garg lab is known for making breakthroughs in catalysis, especially strong bond activation of esters and amides using nickel catalysts,<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Hie |first1=Liana |last2=Fine Nathel |first2=Noah F. |last3=Shah |first3=Tejas K. |last4=Baker |first4=Emma L. |last5=Hong |first5=Xin |last6=Yang |first6=Yun-Fang |last7=Liu |first7=Peng |last8=Houk |first8=K. N. |last6=Garg |first6=Neil K. |date=2025-02-12 |title=σ-Bond insertion reactions of two strained diradicaloids |url=https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-025-08745-1 |journal=Nature |language=en |pages=1–3 |doi=10.1038/s41586-025-08745-1 |pmid=39938569 |issn=1476-4687|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Yamano |first1=Michael M. |last2=Kelleghan |first2=Andrew V. |last3=Shao |first3=Qianzhen |last4=Giroud |first4=Maude |last5=Simmons |first5=Bryan J. |last6=Li |first6=Bo |last7=Chen |first7=Shuming |last8=Houk |first8=K. N. |last8=Garg |first8=Neil K. |date=November 2024 |title=A solution to the anti-Bredt olefin synthesis problem |url=https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.adq3519 |journal=Science |volume=386 |issue=6721 |article-number=eadq3519 |doi=10.1126/science.adq3519|pmid=39480919 |bibcode=2024Sci...386q3519M |url-access=subscription }}</ref>  They also developed synthetic chemistry of cubene and quadricyclene<ref name=":4">{{Cite journal |last=Ding |first=Jiaming |last2=French |first2=Sarah A. |last3=Rivera |first3=Christina A. |last4=Tena Meza |first4=Arismel |last5=Witkowski |first5=Dominick C. |last6=Houk |first6=K. The Garg laboratory has completed the total syntheses of many natural products, including welwitindolinones, akuammilines, tubingensin alkaloids, and lissodendoric acid A.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Ippoliti |first1=Francesca M. |last2=Adamson |first2=Nathan J. |last3=Wonilowicz |first3=Laura G. |last4=Nasrallah |first4=Daniel J. |last5=Darzi |first5=Evan R. |last6=Donaldson |first6=Joyann S. |last7=Garg |first7=Neil K. |date=2023-01-20 |title=Total synthesis of lissodendoric acid A via stereospecific trapping of a strained cyclic allene |journal=Science |volume=379 |issue=6629 |pages=261–265 |doi=10.1126/science.ade0032 |pmc=10462259 |pmid=36656952|bibcode=2023Sci...379..261I }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Publications |url=https://garg.chem.ucla.edu/publications |access-date=2024-07-28 |website=Garg Lab |language=en-US}}</ref> In 2020, Garg co-Founded ElectraTect, Inc.<ref>{{cite web|title=ElectraTect|url=https://electratect.com/|access-date=December 19, 2022}}</ref>

Garg is also a prominent educator and science communicator. He has received many accolades for his classroom teaching, including the [[Robert Foster Cherry Award|Cherry Award]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=How did organic chemistry become so beloved at UCLA? ==Career==
{{BLP unreferenced section|date=October 2023}}
Sources:<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Neil K. Garg – John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation… |url=https://www.gf.org/fellows/neil-k-garg/ |access-date=2024-07-28 |language=en}}</ref>

Garg received his B.S. from [[New York University]] in 2000.  He went on to earn his Ph.D. at the [[California Institute of Technology]], where he studied organic chemistry under the supervision of [[Brian Stoltz]] as a [[DoD NDSEG Fellowship|DoD NDSEG Fellow]], completing his studies in 2005. Upon completion of his graduate work, he held an NIH post-doctoral appointment in the [[laboratory]] of [[Larry Overman]] at [[University of California - Irvine]] from 2005 to 2007.<ref>{{Cite web |title=About Neil |url=https://garg.chem.ucla.edu/about-neil |access-date=2025-03-24 |website=Garg Lab |language=en-US}}</ref>

Garg was promoted to Distinguished Professor at [[UCLA]] in 2020. In 2018, he became the inaugural holder of the [[Kenneth N. Trueblood]] Endowed Chair in Chemistry & Biochemistry. He has served as Vice Chair for the Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry (2012-2016) and (2023–present) and served as the Department Chair (2019–2023).<ref name=":0" /> He also served as Faculty-in-Residence in the UCLA dormitories from 2012-2021.
